objective: Make Android Home, Wall, Connect and Profile returns near-instant by retaining previously opened dashboard screens instead of popping/remounting them on every global tab switch. Preserve Cluster as root workspace and scope/ads/media security gates.
productionBaselineEvidence: As of Nov 17 2026, GitHub main source SHA 0ee57887 inspected. PR #900 documents Android staging-user runtime 1.3.2 OTA 01a1e6c4-e877-7036-8573-58c1424e392c; production remains separately controlled and no current device timings or live production fingerprint were verified. This work is DEV only.
chosenApproach: Use Expo Router SDK 57 persistent lazy Tabs exclusively for Android within existing authenticated (tabs) layout, suppress internal tab bar because root BuklodNavSafeShell owns it, keep blurred tabs frozen/native detached, retain web/iOS Stack fallback, no offscreen prefetch that could start AdMob/video work.
selectionRationale: React Navigation Stack navigate can pop intermediate screens and cold-mount them again on later visits, while bottom tabs retain their state and make repeat switching cheaper. No native dependency, backend, routing destination or ad policy changes.
alternativeApproaches: Eagerly mount all five dashboards on boot (rejected: high startup memory, CPU, media and ad lifecycle risk).
Use router.prefetch for every tab (rejected for this change: offscreen rendering might start network/media/ad work, subject to additional safeguards).
Fire navigation on touch-down (rejected: breaks drag/scroll cancellation).
preserveBehaviors: Signed Android package/runtime and all OTA channels, auth/consent/managed scope gates, profile and onboarding unchanged.
Original Home, Wall, Connect, Profile and Cluster canonical URLs and global bottom nav preserved.
On first visit an unvisited dashboard is lazy-mounted; subsequent visits reuse state. Offline and slow-network content remains asynchronous.
AdMob genuine SDK fill/impression/viewability/consent/cooldown, first-view prewarm and blurred-screen request guard untouched.
Offscreen Wall videos and Connect reactions remain subject to existing focus/scroll lifecycle; no new prefetch network requests.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Android authenticated dashboard lifecycle changes from a stack to persistent frozen tabs; preserve every existing session and route guard.
preservedBehaviors: Existing runtime 1.3.2, authenticated session, compliance/onboarding and app-wide navigation behavior remain unchanged.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Expo Router Android tab navigator owns persistent dashboard scenes while root authentication, scope and canonical navigation retain authority.
preservedBehaviors: Current auth, privacy/consent, Cluster-to-Public scope isolation and all dashboard route destinations remain enforced.

acceptanceChecks: Exact-source static test and TypeScript compilation pass.
Android EAS Hermes preview smoke verifies Home->Wall->Connect->Profile->Home->Wall remains state-preserving, no blank screen or nonfocusing tab.
Cluster->Public global navigation still restores Public scope before exposing any personal/global tab.
Offscreen video stops, first-view advertisements do not lose fill/restart unnecessarily, privacy-safe foreground requests and consent remain intact.
On actual Android target handset, measure tap release to visible route (warm <150ms p95 target); cold first visit must show content shell promptly. Numbers are targets, not measured claims.
No staging, RC or production OTA until native/AdMob/navigation critical release gates; production unchanged.
